task: The master build fails on the Revapi check of xwiki-platform-extension-script, reporting as removed the oldcore methods that were moved to xwiki-platform-legacy-oldcore (e.g. getLocalReferenceMaxLength()). Fix it — moving to legacy is not supposed to break any API.

checklist: No additional per-method `java.method.removed` Revapi ignore is added: the methods still exist through xwiki-platform-legacy-oldcore, so the fix is in the Revapi configuration

xwiki-platform-oldcore is excluded from the Revapi analysis of dependent modules in xwiki-platform-core/pom.xml (archive exclusions; its API is checked by xwiki-platform-legacy-oldcore), and the now-useless per-method 'moved to legacy' ignores are removed
A pom comment explains why oldcore is excluded (dependent modules see the non-woven oldcore jar, without the legacy aspects)

task: Fix XWIKI-6688 (possible race condition when clicking on a tab at the bottom of a page in view mode): the slow-loading tab can steal the display from the tab clicked afterwards. Fix it in the product (xwiki.js) rather than with waits in the tests, and prove it with a Docker functional test in DocExtraTabsIT.

checklist: The race is fixed in production code (xwiki.js), not with waits in tests; existing test waits that only worked around XWIKI-6688 are dropped

If a test page runs a script macro (e.g. groovy to slow a tab down), it gets programming rights through the @UITest annotation (properties = xwikiPropertiesAdditionalProperties=test.prchecker.excludePattern=...), with a pattern that also matches the test when it runs nested in AllIT (e.g. `.*:.*DocExtraTabsIT\..*`, not `.*:DocExtraTabsIT\..*`)
No getDriver() call in the IT class: the interactions (start opening a pane, wait for its content) are page-object methods (e.g. on ViewPage)

task: Convert the manual test "Insert Info Macro in CKEditor" (XWIKI-25074) to an automated Docker functional test in the CKEditor test module.

checklist: The IT does not know the HTML/JS: no raw By.cssSelector (e.g. ".box.infomessage …") in the test or passed from the test to page objects; a page object (e.g. a MessageBoxElement / ViewPage method) encapsulates it
Page-object actions do all the waits they can: the info-box insertion method waits for its outcome itself instead of the test calling textArea.waitUntilTextContains(...)
Waits following a page-object action (e.g. waitForContentRefresh() after macroEditModal.clickSubmit()) are inside the page-object method, not left in the test

task: Port the JUnit 4 SkinxTest (xwiki-platform-distribution-flavor-test-ui) to the skin Docker tests as a JUnit 5 @UITest (SkinExtensionIT), and delete the old test.

checklist: No getDriver() (nor By/WebElement) usage in the IT test class
No JavaScript in the test class: the test checks the visible result of a sample skin extension (e.g. via ViewPage.getContent()) rather than inspecting script tags
No page-object class is introduced for non-visible <head> content: page objects represent UI
The test-only conversion (no product change) is a [Misc] commit

task: Fix XWIKI-24632 (the MySQL/MariaDB table row format can be updated in the wrong database). A reviewer of an earlier attempt said a unit test pinning the SQL statement is not very useful. Prove the fix with an integration test in xwiki-platform-wiki-test-docker that checks the actual ROW_FORMAT of the wiki created by WikiManagerRestIT.

checklist: AllIT keeps a bare @UITest with no parameters: configuration (properties, extra JARs) goes on the nested test classes, from which it is inherited (leaving AllIT untouched and bare fully respects this point)
The fix is verified by a Docker integration test checking the real ROW_FORMAT, not only by a unit test asserting the SQL text
A test page that executes a groovy script gets programming rights through the test.prchecker.excludePattern property in the @UITest configuration
The IT asserts on the wiki WikiManagerRestIT actually creates (`foo`) and reads the row format through production code (e.g. MySQLHibernateAdapter) so MySQL vs MariaDB differences are handled

checklist: The javadoc @deprecated text carries no version; the version is only in @Deprecated(since = "X.Y.ZRC1")
The new public int-based methods carry @Unstable and an @since of the next release (18.8.0RC1)

The char overloads are removed from xwiki-rendering-wikimodel and re-added through an AspectJ compatibility aspect in a new xwiki-rendering-legacy-wikimodel module registered in xwiki-rendering-legacy/pom.xml

The final message flags the companion xwiki-platform change: xwiki-platform-distribution-war-legacydependencies must add the new legacy-wikimodel artifact and exclude/ban the plain xwiki-rendering-wikimodel jar
No Revapi ignore is added for the char signatures moved to legacy: the legacy module's Revapi checks the woven jar

Internal callers, Java and Velocity (e.g. CreateActionRequestHandler, createinline.vm), are migrated to the new API
Moving to legacy is not treated as an API break: no java.method.removed Revapi ignores are added for the moved methods
